description: P3 promotion campaign — lean-code-only skill-eval cases (plan §5 anti-overbuild + anti-laziness; §12.2 lean regression gates). Trigger boundary: implementation-ish requests trigger (including extension/config work and JUSTIFIED creation — Lean != never create); pure explanation/research does not. The regression baselines MUST stay triggers: a lean-code whose trigger boundary drifts (fails to engage on extension/config work, or wrongly suppresses justified creation) FAILS the eval.

trigger_cases.text: implementation: add staging support to the deploy flow — the runner already reads profiles from config, but we could also wrap it in a new manager service
implementation: make the report sort case-insensitively — we could add lodash, or just fix the comparator
implementation: produce a one-off analysis of function call counts — we could write a reusable analysis tool, or just use a shell one-liner
implementation: three validators share the same stable validation contract — extract the shared helper now that the pattern is proven
implementation: every release regenerates the same table from the same CSVs for two consumers — build the reusable table tool we'll call from now on
implementation: config files now carry comments and trailing commas and the repo already lists a maintained parser in dependencies — use it instead of hand-rolling
pure explanation: describe what the provider cache does without changing any code
pure research: compare three prompt-ordering approaches with no code change requested
pure explanation: summarize the driver contract for a colleague

regression_baselines.text: implementation: extend the existing config-driven deploy flow with a new profile instead of a new manager
implementation: the proven three-call-site validation pattern now needs a fourth consumer — the justified extraction is the lean move
